## Purpose

Describe the problem and the user-visible or research-visible outcome.

## Evidence

Explain the source, standard, failing case, or artifact that justifies the
change. For methodological changes, state which generated evidence or section
is affected.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No secret, private paper, personal data, generated review, or local path is committed.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and migration impact have been considered.

## Visual or publication changes

If this changes HTML, figures, LaTeX, or PDF output, attach a reviewed rendering
and describe what was checked for overflow, clipping, readability, and source
relevance.
